Core boundary
Findings, approvals, reports, and migration inventories record review. Target schema changes stay under explicit human control.
textPreview: Findings, approvals, reports, and migration inventories record review. Target schema changes stay under explicit human control.

text: The normal workflow inspects saved schema snapshots. Query Lab separately supports bounded read queries. The workbench supports learning and demonstration, with production database administration outside its scope.

text: P0 reflects the user-defined category of a clear project improvement candidate. JEV output should remain advisory. A small evaluation against existing severity/certainty and representative examples should confirm value before relying on rankings. Source: referenced chat “Prioritize JEV Decision Making.”

text: P1 and P2 items are proposed opportunities from the referenced JEV analysis. Engine suitability currently uses a provisional heuristic, and index experiments use synthetic or sandbox data. Neither should be presented as a validated production recommendation.

text: JEV confidence is a signal, not proof.
textPreview: JEV confidence is a signal, not proof.

text: The referenced chat recommends treating JEV as a structured decision model for bounded questions. Keep deterministic checks as the source of facts and require human review for high-impact actions. This deck describes the planned JEV layer, not existing implementation.
